data.title: 桃乐丝 · 休息室里的旧书签
data.description: 桃乐丝穿烟粉开衫坐在休息室沙发边，从书中取出一枚微旧的金属书签。她用软布慢慢擦亮边缘，紫眸认真停在磨损的小角上，平日周到的迎宾笑容换成安静的沉思。
data.action: 用软布擦亮旧书签，凝视磨损的一角。
data.promptProse: Dorothy sits beside the lounge sofa, polishing a worn metal bookmark slowly with a soft cloth. Her muted-rose cardigan covers an ivory blouse above a charcoal calf-length skirt; violet eyes linger on one scuffed corner without the usual welcoming smile. The medium view includes the open book and sofa cushion nearby. Side-window light catches the bookmark edge and long pink hair, with quieter cloth shadows and subdued upholstery behind her reflective expression.
